text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone supported me... me! They made it 
so I could run faster than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And yet... what the heck am I doing?! 
Everyone gave me so much— and here I am 
giving nothing back!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you supposed to repay them for 
everything...?!
choice_data_list:
If you feel that frustrated, you'll be 
just fine.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you supposed to repay them for 
everything...?!
choice_data_list:
If you feel that frustrated, you'll be 
just fine.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Trainer... You don't have to say 
such kind words to me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please get angry at me. Scold me for being 
so pathetic. If you don't, I...
choice_data_list:
Let's do our best together again, the two 
of us!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Even when I say I don't want to, 
you still encourage me, don't you...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. ...I won't let it end 
like this.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I want to repay everyone. No, I 
HAVE to repay them. So—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Next time. Next time, I will definitely do 
it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“—No way! If I give up now, then... I'll 
have nothing left...!”
choice_data_list: Then there's only one thing to do, right?

In that case, isn't there only one thing 
to do?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. That's... that's right. I don't 
have time to just stand around doing 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I have to take it all back from here on 
out. Otherwise... I won't be able to repay 
that kindness."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Will you keep doing your 
best with someone like me by your side?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you very much. I've found 
my resolve once again.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best. Even more so. More than 
anyone."
